name: hairpin
description: add_hairpin has no effect in form-extension context: it returns an honest error ('add hairpin had no effect ...') and creates no hairpin (before/after count 0). Observed identically with and without notes present, in both full-suite and isolated runs 2026-05-20 -- the same #24673-class cmd-dispatch failure as add_slur/add_ottava. Asserted as an honest-error tool.

steps.prompt: Add a crescendo hairpin from measure 1 beat 1 to measure 2 beat 1 staff 1.
Add a diminuendo hairpin from measure 3 beat 1 to measure 4 beat 1 staff 1.
